label: Bible Study
prompt: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a _____?
verse: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
note: Paul's chain of questions — no preacher, no hearing; no hearing, no believing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing _____.
verse: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
note: James's simple prescription: troubled? pray. Merry? sing psalms. Both roads lead to God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two _____.
verse: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
note: Two mites made only a farthing (Mark 12:42), yet Jesus said this widow gave more than all the rich donors.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The days of our years are _____ years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verse: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
note: A score is twenty, so threescore and ten is seventy — from the only psalm credited to Moses.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the _____ waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verse: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
note: The 'husbandman' is a farmer, not a spouse — and he waits patiently for the early and latter rain.
